notes.title: Version 1.07 Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.07 Update 
[list]
[*] Remapped and improved Vive Controllers 
[*] Improved Oculus Touch Controllers 
[*] Added support for multiple different sound types including 5.1 surround Sound, 7.1 Surround and ProLogic
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.06 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] For Keyboard Control - moved the Map Key from “M” to “Q” for easier access. 
[*] Improved messaging for which controller provides the best experience.
[/list]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - No Way Out - A Dead Realm Tale
notes.notes:
No Way Out - A Dead Realm Tale is Now Available on Steam!

No Way Out: A Dead Realm Tale is a chilling VR experience that takes you to hell and back! Race against the clock as you solve puzzles in this haunted mansion caught between our world and the Dead Realm. Will you escape? Or will you become just another lost soul trapped forever in Huxley’s Mansion?
